description: This file is a shell script that compares the size of OpenWrt packages against upstream data. It reads configuration, fetches package index files, and performs size comparison operations to evaluate storage impact.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays the script usage information extracted from comments starting with ###.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Retrieves size information for a specified package from a given index file, either installed size or package size depending on configuration.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Iterates over configured packages, computes size differences between local files and upstream indices, and outputs a comparison report.
